title: Add E2E game test: GatherWood scenario
description:
## Problem
There is no end-to-end game test that validates the full agent pipeline against a real Minecraft server + Mineflayer adapter. Unit tests cover individual components but cannot detect integration issues in the dispatch→adapter→event→completion loop.

## Scope
Implement a controlled E2E test for the "GatherWood" scenario:

1. **Infrastructure setup:**
   - Script or compose file to spin up a disposable Minecraft server (MC 1.16.5) + Mineflayer adapter
   - Test harness that connects the agent to the server
   - Cleanup/teardown on completion

2. **Test scenario:**
   - Agent receives "gather 3 oak logs" command
   - Verifies agent plans: SearchMemory → MoveTo → MineBlock (3x) → GetStatus
   - Verifies 3 oak_logs appear in inventory
   - Verifies no TIMED OUT warnings in agent log
   - Times out after 120 seconds

3. **Assertions:**
   - Action sequence matches expected plan
   - All dispatched actions reach Completed state
   - Inventory delta shows +3 oak_logs
   - Agent log contains no errors

## Files
- Scripts/Start-E2ETest.ps1 (new — orchestration script)
- MemorySmith.Agent.Tests/E2E/GatherWoodScenario.cs (new)

## Dependencies
- Docker or local Java for Minecraft server
- Mineflayer adapter running in Node.js
- Requires configured MemorySmith API instance or mock

## Validation
- Test passes consistently (3/3 runs)
- Test cleans up server and adapter on completion
